notes: Group: Everything Else. COMBO / FULL-CARD OVERLAY (756×1099) over Green Squadron A-wing. Title bar: starship disc (as printed), '••Jedi Starfighter' (restricted ••), destiny 2. LORE BOX PRINTED EMPTY → lore '' (printed lore kept in base_lore; VB5 reissue also has the empty box). Right of the lore box: the Death Star II ring (as printed) and, below it, a black EPISODE I disc added by the slip → ring_icons ['episode1']. Art window blank. Banner 'STARFIGHTER – JEDI INTERCEPTOR' (spaced en-dash); POWER 2 / MANEUVER ✶ / HYPERSPEED 6 — the maneuver value is Decipher's black eight-pointed star glyph (sheet text layer 'X', stub 'X'), written ✶ as in vs4/50 and vs8/15; the same glyph opens '✶ = pilot’s ability'. Scomp ring; deploy 3 / forfeit 5. 'Obi-wan' with lower-case w as printed (VB5 reissue corrects to Obi-Wan and uses 'STARFIGHTER: JEDI INTERCEPTOR'). Icon column: square lavender Republic tile, Nav Computer; then VS16 sphere. Credits under the text box: 'Original concept by Steven Lewis' / 'Georgia States 2007'. Layout matches the printed card's proportions. CHANGES vs printed Green Squadron A-wing (DS2, •••, STARFIGHTER: A-WING): title → ••Jedi Starfighter; destiny 3 → 2; lore removed; Episode I icon added; POWER 3 → 2, MANEUVER 5 → ✶, HYPERSPEED 4 → 6; deploy 4 → 3, forfeit 3 → 5; icons Pilot + Nav → Republic + Nav; text replaced (printed: 'Deploy -2 to Sullust or same system or sector as Green Leader. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2 and adds 2 to power. Power -1 when opponent has a starfighter present with a higher maneuver.'). Base lore matches the scan. Base scan only 350 px; DS2 copyright by set. Modern: VB5-L-jedistarfighter-pre.gif (Virtual Block 5 reissue, A-wing art).
